bagPolicy.summary: Levi’s Stadium enforces a strict bag policy prohibiting most bags, with exceptions for clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutch bags. All bags are subject to inspection.
allowed: Approved clear bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
One-gallon clear plastic zip lock-type bags
prohibited: Bags that violate the Clear Bag Policy
Lights, tripods, selfie-sticks, monopods and poles
Cans, glass bottles or alcoholic beverages
Confetti, fireworks, flares, optical illusions, laser pointers
Glow sticks, light-up costumes, light-up signs, battery packs larger than your cell phone
Klaxons, bullhorns, whistles, or any other noisemakers
Flags, Signs, or banners larger than 2’ by 3’
Drugs, Drug paraphernalia, marijuana, marijuana products
Helmets not purchased from the team store
Hoods, masks, or face coverings that hide one’s identity
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags are allowed but must be inspected and marked with a wristband or sticker.

parking.note: Levi's Stadium offers a variety of parking options including Premium Red, Pink, Blue, Green, and Yellow lots. Tailgating is permitted in some lots with restrictions on open flames and glass containers. It's recommended to follow game day traffic patterns for the best routes.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Levi’s Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Levi's Stadium offers a wide variety of food and beverage options, including hot dogs, nachos, sandwiches, and specialty cocktails. Highlights include the Faithful Frank Hot Dog, Micheladas, and a selection of premium canned and draft beers. Concession options may vary by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Once accessible parking is full, guests with a valid and current DMV-issued Disabled Person Placard or License Plate and a parking pass to a Levi’s® Stadium parking lot will be directed to a mobility-friendly parking lot that provides a courtesy shuttle. (i.e., Blue Lot 1, Pink Lots 4/5/8).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at any Levi’s® Stadium event.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Gameday Will Call opens three (3) hours before kickoff. Will call requests received before gameday will be forwarded in advance of the game to the intended recipient via the San Francisco 49ers App or by email.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Levi’s Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
